fields.description: Program Description 1. Traning Objectives Editor Note: Students of this major mainly study the basic theories and knowledge of management, economics and enterprise management, receive basic training in enterprise management methods and skills, and have the basic ability to analyze and solve enterprise management problems. This major cultivates senior professionals in business administration who have the knowledge and ability in management, economy, law and enterprise management, and can engage in management, teaching and scientific research in enterprises, institutions and government departments. After four years of study, graduates should master the basic principles of management and economics, as well as the basic theories and knowledge of modern enterprise management; Grasp the qualitative and quantitative analysis methods of enterprise management; Strong language and written expression, interpersonal communication and basic ability to analyze and solve enterprise management problems; Be familiar with the relevant guidelines, policies and regulations of enterprise management and the practices and rules of international enterprise management; Understand the theoretical frontier and development trends of this discipline; Master the basic methods of literature retrieval and data query, and have preliminary scientific research and practical work ability. 2. Main Courses Editor Notes: Courses may change every year, so they are only for reference. Management, microeconomics, macroeconomics, management information system, statistics, accounting, financial management, marketing, economic law, human resource management, finance and taxation, finance, real estate development and management, real estate regulations, real estate appraisal, project management, enterprise strategic management, etc. 3. Employment Direction Editor Notes: Many of the gtaduates are engaged in various industrial and commercial enterprises, financial institutions and government economic management departments. After graduation, students can be employed in various industrial and commercial enterprises, financial institutions and government economic management departments. You can obtain graduate students in economics and management, as well as professional qualification certificates such as asset appraisers, real estate appraisers, certified public accountants and tax agents, cost engineers, ISO9000 certification, etc. 4. Introduction of School of Business Editor Notes: Recently, the graduate employment rate has been above 90%, and graduates with comprehensive quality and outstanding competence were widely praised by enterprises and bosses. The School of Business (SB) has 96 employees. Among them, there are 47 professors and associate professors, 51 doctors and doctor candidates. The school is privileged for a number of phenomenal academics, such as an expert with State-Council Allowance, 2 middle-aged and young experts with outstanding contributions in Shandong Province, a well-known technical expert in Shandong Province and 2 college-level distinguished teachers. SB has 4 research centers, 3 research institutes, 3 laboratories and 24 teaching and practice bases. The school also reaches mutual credit recognition and cooperation agreements with Australia, the United States, France and other foreign universities. 5. School Introduction Editor Notes: XJTU is a member of Chinese Ivy League Universities. Shandong Jianzhu University (SJU) is situated in Jinan, the beautiful capital city of Shandong Province, P. R. China. Shandong Province has a time-honored history and has served as a pivotal cultural and religious site for Taoism, Chinese Buddhism, and Confucianism. Shandong has emerged as one of the most populous and most affluent provinces in China. Jinan is also called "Spring City" and has a considerable number of tourist attractions such as Baotu Spring, Daming Lake and Qianfo Mountain. Learn More>> 6. Campus Life Editor Notes: There are various kinds of activities on and off campus. Internships ​ Communicate with Enterprises ​ ​​

fields.materials: Application Materials " * " means necessary documents that you must provide in your application. If you want to book our translation service , please pay and book it at least 2 weeks before the application deadline for submission of all documents; If you want to book our guardian service , you need to pay and book it 2 months before the application deadline, just in case your application fails because of failed to submit application documents on time. * 1. 2-inch photo * 2. Photocopy of passport(including personal information page and Chinese visa pages). * 3. High school graduate certificate Graduation certificate in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization. * 4. High school academic transcript High school academic transcript in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization. * 5. English proficiency certificate * 6. Non-criminal record The applicant must submit a valid certificate of no criminal record issued by the local public security organization, which should be valid within six months from the application date. * 7. Proof of financial guarantee (1) Scanned copies of passport or identification document of the financial guarantor(limited to the applicant or immediate family member) (2) Proof of financial support, with deposits of no less than 20,000 RMB or an equivalent amount in foreign currency. * 8. Physical Examination Form Forms will be deemed invalid if they are incomplete, lack attached photos, do not have a cross-page seal on the photo, lack asignature of the attending physician, or are without an official hospital stamp. The validity period of the examination result is 6 months (it must be within the validity period during the time of application). You can download a template or sample from here . * 9. A Self-introduction Video -Pease send us a vdeo of 3-5 minutes replying the folowing questions (for bachelor degree applicants) -1.Please introduce yourself in the following aspects nationality, performance in high school in detail(how many years in high school in your country, how many subjects, overall performance, etc), favourite subjects, hobbies, etc, -2. What major do you apply? Why? -3. What's your plan after you get the bachelor degree? -4. Tell us about your family and also state your economic supply during the 4 years' study if you are admitted? -5. How much do you know the relationship between China and your mother country? -6. How much do you konw about the international business exchange(for business applicants)/infrastructure cooperation( for civil engineering application) between China and your mother country? Tips: For applicants who are in China: If you are an employee, you still need to provide employment separation certificate and your current residence permit. If you are a student, you need to provide transfer certificate, leaving certificate, certificate of attendance rate issued by previous school and your current residence permit.
fields.requirements: Entry Requirements Applicants must be citizens with a valid foreign passport, whose nationalities are not People's Republic of China. 18-25 years old. Those overseas applicants who were residents of Chinese mainland,Hong Kong,Macao and Taiwai must have held the valid foreign passport or certificates of nationality for at least four years, and over two years(nine-month actual residence in foreign countries within one year can be caltulated as one year,subject to the entry and exit date) of the actural foreign residence record within the last four years. Applicants for undergraduate programs should hold high school diploma or above. Applicants for English taught programs should provide IELTS or TOEFL test results or English Proficiency certificates. Thoese who complete high school or university courses in English should provide relevant evidence; English-speaking applicants do not need to provide proof of English Proficiency.
